CALLER REPORTS A VESSEL EXPLODED AT HOFFMAN'S MARINA FUELING DOCK ON THE MANASQUAN RIVER. Medium Affected: WATER

Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 12 gallons
CALLER STATED THAT A TOW TRUCK WAS TOWING A MINIVAN DOWN THE ROAD. THE DRIVER OF THE TOW TRUCK LOOKED DOWN TO GET A CIGARETTE, AND WHEN HE LOOKED UP, HE WAS OFF THE ROAD, DRIVING DOWN AND EMBANKMENT, AND INTO THE RIVER. THE DRIVER AND THE PASSENGER OF THE TOW TRUCK WERE SENT TO THE HOSPITAL, BUT WERE SUBSEQUENTLY RELEASED WITHOUT INJURIES. THE TOW TRUCK AND THE MINIVAN WERE TOWED OUT BY A THIRD PARTY TOW TRUCK CONTRACTOR. TOW TRUCK TOWING MINIVAN, DRIVING DOWN STREET, OPERATOR ERROR, DROVE DOWN INTO RIVER
